articles.title: The Bloop: How a Deep-Sea Mystery Turned Out to Be a Chilling Warning from Antarctica
articles.summary: A mysterious ultra-low-frequency sound recorded across the Pacific in 1997 sparked theories of giant sea creatures. After an 8-year investigation, NOAA scientists confirmed the source: a massive ice quake. The discovery reveals a story about climate change — and a continent of ice that’s slowly dying.

articles.title: “The Room Returns”: Bob Odenkirk Leads a Bizarre, No-Budget Charity Remake of a Cult Classic
articles.summary: The infamous cult film “The Room” is being remade as a charity project starring Bob Odenkirk. Shot in a single day with zero budget, “The Room Returns” flips the original’s chaotic production on its head. The premiere at Hollywood Forever Cemetery will benefit cancer and AIDS research, plus support for independent artists.

articles.title: Fox Bets Big on Creator Freedom, Inking Deals with Josh Richards, Emelia Hartford, and More
articles.summary: Fox Creator Studios has signed seven new digital creators, including Josh Richards and Emelia Hartford, to produce original shows. In an unusual move, Fox finances the projects but gives creators full creative control — no notes, no final cut. The strategy aims to build durable IP by trusting creators to know their audiences.
